nodes.description: 两个平面的法向量共线时，这两个平面平行或重合。
nodes.name: Using Vectors to Determine Whether Two Planes Are Parallel

nodes.description: 直线的方向向量与平面的法向量共线时，直线与平面垂直。
nodes.name: Using Vectors to Determine Whether a Line Is Perpendicular to a Plane

nodes.description: 两个平面的法向量互相垂直时，这两个平面互相垂直。
nodes.name: Using Vectors to Determine Whether Two Planes Are Perpendicular

nodes.description: 异面或相交直线的夹角、直线与平面所成的角，都可以化为方向向量、法向量的夹角。
nodes.name: Angles in Space

nodes.description: 二面角的大小可以用法向量的夹角来表示，取法向量时要注意哪一侧是二面角的内部。
nodes.name: Dihedral angles using plane normal vectors

nodes.description: 点到平面 ax+by+cz+d=0 的距离等于把点代入后的绝对值除以法向量的模。
nodes.name: Distance from a Point to a Plane

nodes.description: 把平行、垂直和距离都写成向量条件后，可以用坐标运算代替一部分几何证明。
nodes.name: Using Vectors to Solve Simple Solid Geometry Problems
nodes.nameZh: 用向量解决简单立体几何问题

nodes.description: The inclination of an unoriented line is its counterclockwise angle from the positive x-axis, chosen in [0,180) degrees. Horizontal lines have inclination 0 and vertical lines 90 degrees.
nodes.name: Angle of Inclination of a Line

nodes.description: 斜率是倾斜角的正切。倾斜角为 90 度时直线与 x 轴垂直，斜率不存在。
nodes.name: Slope of a line

nodes.description: 过不同两点 (x1，y1)、(x2，y2) 的直线，在 x1≠x2 时斜率为 (y2−y1)/(x2−x1)。
nodes.name: Slope formula for a line through two points

nodes.description: For two lines with finite slopes, equal slopes mean parallel or coincident lines; strict parallelism also requires distinctness. The product of slopes is -1 exactly when those two nonvertical lines are perpendicular. Treat vertical and horizontal lines separately.
nodes.name: Using slopes to determine parallelism and perpendicularity
nodes.nameZh: 用斜率判断平行与垂直

nodes.description: 过点 (x0，y0)、斜率为 k 的直线可以写成 y−y0=k(x−x0)。
nodes.name: Point-slope form of a line

nodes.description: 与两条坐标轴分别交于 (a，0)、(0，b) 且 a、b 都不为 0 的直线，可以写成 x/a+y/b=1。
nodes.name: Intercept form of a line

nodes.description: 平面内的直线都可以写成 Ax+By+C=0，其中 A、B 不全为 0。B≠0 时斜率为 −A/B。
nodes.name: General equation of a line

nodes.description: 两条直线的交点坐标是它们的方程联立后的公共解。
nodes.name: Intersection of two lines

nodes.description: 平面上两点的距离等于横、纵坐标之差的平方和的算术平方根。
nodes.name: Distance between two points

nodes.description: 点 (x0，y0) 到直线 Ax+By+C=0 的距离是 |Ax0+By0+C| 除以 √(A²+B²)。
nodes.name: Distance from a point to a line

nodes.description: 两条平行直线 Ax+By+C1=0 与 Ax+By+C2=0 的距离是 |C1−C2| 除以 √(A²+B²)。
nodes.name: Distance between parallel lines

nodes.description: 圆心为 (a，b)、半径为 r 的圆，方程是 (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r²。
nodes.name: Standard Equation of a Circle

nodes.description: x²+y²+Dx+Ey+F=0 在 D²+E²−4F>0 时表示圆，圆心是 (−D/2，−E/2)。
nodes.name: General Equation of a Circle

nodes.description: 圆心、半径或圆上的点可以确定圆的方程，常用待定系数。
nodes.name: Determining the Equation of a Circle from Given Conditions

nodes.description: 圆心到直线的距离 d 与半径 r 比较：d<r 相交，d=r 相切，d>r 相离。
nodes.name: Relative Positions of a Line and a Circle

nodes.description: 弦心距为 d、半径为 r 时，半弦长是 √(r²−d²)，弦长是它的 2 倍。
nodes.name: Chords Cut from Lines by Circles

nodes.description: For circles of positive radii r1,r2 and center distance d: d=r1+r2 gives external tangency; 0<d=|r1-r2| gives internal tangency; |r1-r2|<d<r1+r2 gives two intersections. If d=0 and r1=r2 the circles coincide. Outside these ranges they have no common point.
nodes.name: Relative positions of two circles

nodes.description: 航线、管道是否与圆形区域相交，可以化成直线与圆的位置关系。
nodes.name: Simple applications of lines and circles

nodes.description: 平面内到两个定点的距离之和等于常数（大于两定点间距离）的点的轨迹是椭圆。
nodes.name: Definition of an ellipse

nodes.description: 焦点在 x 轴上时，椭圆标准方程是 x²/a²+y²/b²=1，其中 a>b>0。
nodes.name: Standard equation of an ellipse

nodes.description: 椭圆中 a、b、c 满足 c²=a²−b²，焦距是 2c，离心率是 c/a。
nodes.name: Relationship among a, b, and c in an ellipse

nodes.description: 焦点在 x 轴上的椭圆，长轴长 2a，短轴长 2b，范围是 −a≤x≤a、−b≤y≤b。
nodes.name: Basic Geometric Properties of Ellipses

nodes.description: 行星轨道、椭圆形场地可以用椭圆的长半轴、短半轴和距离之和描述。
nodes.name: Simple Applications of Ellipses

nodes.description: A nondegenerate hyperbola is the locus of points whose absolute difference of distances to two distinct foci is a fixed positive constant strictly smaller than the focal separation. Zero difference gives the perpendicular bisector, not a hyperbola.
nodes.name: Definition of a Hyperbola

nodes.description: 焦点在 x 轴上时，双曲线标准方程是 x²/a²−y²/b²=1。
nodes.name: Standard Equation of a Hyperbola

nodes.description: 焦点在 x 轴上时，实轴长 2a，虚轴长 2b，并且 c²=a²+b²。
nodes.name: Basic Geometric Properties of Hyperbolas
nodes.nameZh: 双曲线的简单几何性质

nodes.description: 双曲线 x²/a²−y²/b²=1 的渐近线是 y=(b/a)x 和 y=−(b/a)x。
nodes.name: Asymptotes of a Hyperbola

nodes.description: 平面内到一个定点和一条定直线的距离相等的点的轨迹是抛物线。定点是焦点，定直线是准线。
nodes.name: Definition of a Parabola

nodes.description: 顶点在原点、焦点在 x 轴正半轴的抛物线是 y²=2px（p>0），焦点是 (p/2，0)。
nodes.name: Standard Equation of a Parabola

nodes.description: y²=2px（p>0）的范围是 x≥0，对称轴是 x 轴，准线是 x=−p/2。
nodes.name: Basic Geometric Properties of a Parabola
nodes.nameZh: 抛物线的简单几何性质

nodes.description: 探照灯、卫星天线的截面常用抛物线，光线平行于轴时会汇到焦点。
nodes.name: Simple Applications of Parabolas

nodes.description: 把直线代入椭圆方程，得到的二次方程有几个实根，直线与椭圆就有几个交点。
nodes.name: Number of intersection points of a line and an ellipse
nodes.nameZh: 直线与椭圆的交点个数

nodes.description: 数列是按一定顺序排成的一列数，每一项都有确定的序号。
nodes.name: Concept of a Sequence

nodes.description: 数列可以用列举、通项公式或图象表示。图象是一串孤立的点。
nodes.name: Representations of sequences

nodes.description: 通项公式用序号 n 表示第 n 项。知道通项就可以求出指定的一项。
nodes.name: Formula for the nth term

nodes.description: 递推公式用前面的项表示后面的项。知道首项和递推，就可以逐项算下去。
nodes.name: Simple recurrence relations

nodes.description: 从第 2 项起，每一项与前一项的差都等于同一个常数，这个数列就是等差数列，常数叫做公差。
nodes.name: Concept of an arithmetic sequence

nodes.description: 首项 a1、公差 d 的等差数列，通项是 a_n=a1+(n−1)d。
nodes.name: General Term of an Arithmetic Sequence

nodes.description: 若 a、b、c 成等差数列，则 2b=a+c，b 是 a 与 c 的等差中项。
nodes.name: Arithmetic Mean

nodes.description: 前 n 项和 S_n=n(a1+a_n)/2，也可以写成 S_n=na1+n(n−1)d/2。
nodes.name: Sum of the First n Terms of an Arithmetic Sequence
nodes.nameZh: 等差数列的前 n 项和

nodes.description: An arithmetic sequence has a_n=d*n+(a1-d) on positive integer indices. For d nonzero this is the restriction of a nonconstant affine line with slope d; d=0 gives a constant sequence. Read the common difference from the coefficient of n.
nodes.name: Arithmetic Sequences and Linear Functions

nodes.description: 分期等额增加的存款、座位排数等，常常可以看成等差数列。
nodes.name: Applications of Arithmetic Sequences

nodes.description: 从第 2 项起，每一项与前一项的比都等于同一个非零常数，这个数列就是等比数列，常数叫做公比。
nodes.name: The concept of geometric sequences

nodes.description: 首项 a1、公比 q 的等比数列，通项是 a_n=a1·q^(n−1)。
nodes.name: The general term of a geometric sequence

nodes.description: 若 a、G、b 成等比数列且各项同号，则 G²=ab。G 是 a 与 b 的等比中项。
nodes.name: Geometric mean

nodes.description: 公比 q≠1 时，S_n=a1(q^n−1)/(q−1)。q=1 时，S_n=na1。
nodes.name: The sum of the first n terms of a geometric sequence
nodes.nameZh: 等比数列的前 n 项和

nodes.description: A geometric sequence under the consecutive-ratio definition has a_n=a1*q^(n-1), with a1 nonzero, q nonzero and positive integer indices. For q>0 and q!=1 it extends to a real exponential-type function; q=1 is constant. A negative q gives an alternating sequence without an ordinary real exponential extension to every real input.
nodes.name: Geometric sequences and exponential functions

nodes.description: 按同一比率增长或衰减的量，可以用等比数列表示。
nodes.name: Applications of Geometric Sequences

nodes.description: 数学归纳法先验证起点成立，再证明「若 n=k 成立则 n=k+1 成立」，从而对全体正整数成立。
nodes.name: The Principle of Mathematical Induction

nodes.description: 证明与正整数有关的等式时，要写清起点和从 k 到 k+1 的推导。
nodes.name: Proving Simple Propositions by Mathematical Induction
nodes.nameZh: 用数学归纳法证明简单命题

nodes.description: 函数在区间上的平均变化率是函数值的增量除以自变量的增量。
nodes.name: Average Rate of Change

nodes.description: 让自变量的增量趋于 0，平均变化率的极限就是瞬时变化率。这里只用具体的有理结果认识这个过程。
nodes.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change and the Idea of Limits
nodes.nameZh: 瞬时变化率与极限思想

nodes.description: 函数在一点的导数就是这一点的瞬时变化率。导数仍是自变量的函数，记为 f'(x)。
nodes.name: The concept of the derivative

nodes.description: 把每一点的导数值合在一起，就得到导函数。原函数和导函数的定义域可能不同。
nodes.name: The derivative function

nodes.description: 函数在一点的导数，是曲线在这一点处切线的斜率。
nodes.name: Geometric meaning of the derivative

nodes.description: 曲线在 (x0，y0) 处的切线，斜率是 f'(x0)，方程用点斜式书写。
nodes.name: Equations of tangent lines

nodes.description: 常函数导数为 0，(x^n)'=nx^(n−1)。正整数次幂可以据此直接求导。
nodes.name: Derivatives of basic elementary functions

nodes.description: 和的导数是导数的和，差也一样。常数倍可以提到导数符号外面。
nodes.name: Derivative sum, difference, and constant-multiple rules

nodes.description: 形如 f(ax+b) 的导数，等于外层导数乘内层的系数 a。
nodes.name: Derivatives of Simple Composite Functions

nodes.description: 在一个区间上 f'(x)>0 时函数递增，f'(x)<0 时函数递减。
nodes.name: Derivatives and Monotonicity

nodes.description: 先求导，再解 f'(x)>0 与 f'(x)<0，得到不超过三次的多项式函数的单调区间。
nodes.name: Using Derivatives to Find Intervals of Monotonicity

nodes.description: At a differentiable interior local extremum the derivative is zero; the converse is false. When the derivative has one sign throughout a left neighborhood and the opposite sign throughout a right neighborhood, its sign change is a sufficient local maximum/minimum test. This sufficient test need not describe every differentiable extremum.
nodes.name: Conditions for Local Extrema

nodes.description: A continuous real function on a closed bounded interval attains its extrema. Compare relevant interior extrema and endpoints; when using derivatives to find candidates, also inspect points where the derivative does not exist. A derivative-zero list alone is insufficient for a merely continuous function.
nodes.name: Extrema on a Closed Interval

nodes.description: 把面积、利润写成函数后，用导数求定义域内的最大或最小值。
nodes.name: Solving Optimization Problems Using Derivatives

nodes.description: 课标要求用导数研究不超过三次的多项式。三次多项式的导数是二次函数。
nodes.name: Polynomial Functions of Degree at Most 3
nodes.nameZh: 不超过三次的多项式函数

nodes.description: 完成一件事有若干类办法，类与类互斥，总办法数等于各类办法数相加。
nodes.name: Addition Principle of Counting

nodes.description: 完成一件事要依次做若干步，每步的办法数相乘就是总办法数。
nodes.name: Multiplication Principle of Counting

nodes.description: 一件事里既有分类又有分步时，先分清哪一段相加、哪一段相乘，再合并。
nodes.name: Combined Counting Using Addition and Multiplication

nodes.description: 从 n 个不同元素中取出 k 个排成一列，顺序不同算不同的排列。
nodes.name: Concept of permutations

nodes.description: 排列数 A(n,k)=n!/(n−k)!，也就是从 n 起连乘 k 个递减的正整数。
nodes.name: Formula for the number of permutations

nodes.description: 排队、分配不同职务、组成无重复数字，都要按有顺序的选取来计数。
nodes.name: Simple applications of permutations

nodes.description: 从 n 个不同元素中取出 k 个成一组，只看元素、不看顺序，叫做组合。
nodes.name: Concept of combinations

nodes.description: 组合数 C(n,k)=n!/(k!(n−k)!)，也等于排列数除以 k 的阶乘。
nodes.name: Formula for the number of combinations

nodes.description: C(n,k)=C(n,n−k)。相邻组合数还有 C(n,k)+C(n,k−1)=C(n+1,k)。
nodes.name: Properties of Combination Numbers

nodes.description: 选人、选物且不计顺序时用组合；若还要按类别分别选取，再把组合数相乘。
nodes.name: Simple Applications of Combinations

nodes.description: (a+b)^n 的展开式是 C(n,k) a^(n−k) b^k 各项的和，k 从 0 取到 n。
nodes.name: Binomial Theorem

nodes.description: 按 a 的降幂排列时，第 k+1 项是 C(n,k) a^(n−k) b^k。可由指数确定 k。
nodes.name: Specified Terms in a Binomial Expansion

nodes.description: 令 a=b=1，可得二项式系数之和等于 2^n。
nodes.name: Sum of Binomial Coefficients

nodes.description: 杨辉三角的第 n 行（n 从 0 数）就是 (a+b)^n 的二项式系数。左右对称，相邻两数之和等于下一行的数。
nodes.name: Properties of Yang Hui's Triangle

nodes.description: For events with P(B)>0, P(A|B)=P(A intersection B)/P(B). In a finite equally likely space this is the proportion of outcomes in B that also belong to A. The elementary ratio is undefined when P(B)=0.
nodes.name: Conditional Probability

nodes.description: When P(A)>0, P(A intersection B)=P(A)*P(B|A). Multiply in event order using the appropriate conditional probabilities. If P(A)=0, the intersection probability is zero directly; the elementary P(B|A) ratio is undefined.
nodes.name: Multiplication Rule for Probability

nodes.description: 若几种原因互斥且覆盖全部可能，事件的概率等于各原因的概率乘以相应条件概率后再相加。
nodes.name: Law of Total Probability

nodes.description: 已知结果已经发生，可以用全概率作分母，求这个结果来自某一原因的概率。
nodes.name: Bayes' Formula

nodes.description: When P(A)>0, A and B are independent exactly when P(B|A)=P(B). Independence means P(A intersection B)=P(A)*P(B), which also covers P(A)=0 without forming an undefined conditional ratio. Independence is different from mutual exclusivity.
nodes.name: Conditional Probability and Independence

nodes.description: 把试验结果对应到实数，得到随机变量。只取有限个或可列个值时，称为离散型。
nodes.name: Discrete Random Variables

nodes.description: 分布列列出随机变量的每个取值和对应概率。所有概率非负，且总和为 1。
nodes.name: Probability Distribution Table

nodes.description: 只取 0 和 1 的随机变量：P(X=1)=p，P(X=0)=1−p。它描述一次试验成功或失败。
nodes.name: Two-Point Distribution

nodes.description: 均值是取值乘对应概率后的和，也叫数学期望。它是概率意义下的加权平均。
nodes.name: Mean of a Discrete Random Variable
nodes.nameZh: 离散型随机变量的均值

nodes.description: 方差是 (取值−均值) 的平方再按概率加权的和。标准差是方差的算术平方根。
nodes.name: Variance of a Discrete Random Variable
nodes.nameZh: 离散型随机变量的方差

nodes.description: 每次试验只有两个结果，成功概率保持为 p，各次相互独立。重复 n 次就是 n 重伯努利试验。
nodes.name: Bernoulli Trials

nodes.description: n 重伯努利试验中，成功次数 X 服从二项分布。P(X=k)=C(n,k) p^k (1−p)^(n−k)。
nodes.name: Binomial Distribution

nodes.description: 若 X 服从 B(n,p)，则均值是 np，方差是 np(1−p)。
nodes.name: Mean and Variance of the Binomial Distribution
nodes.nameZh: 二项分布的均值与方差

nodes.description: 从 N 个产品里含 K 件次品，不放回地抽 n 件。抽到的次品数服从超几何分布。
nodes.name: Hypergeometric Distribution

nodes.description: 不放回抽取 n 件时，抽到的指定类件数的均值是 nK/N。
nodes.name: Mean of a hypergeometric distribution

nodes.description: 正态曲线是单峰、关于均值对称的钟形曲线。均值决定对称轴，方差决定胖瘦。
nodes.name: Characteristics of the normal distribution

nodes.description: 教材常用近似说法：约 68% 的取值落在均值左右 1 个标准差内，约 95% 落在 2 个标准差内。
nodes.name: Empirical rule for the normal curve

nodes.description: 把成对数据画成散点。点大致沿直线上升是正相关，沿直线下降是负相关。
nodes.name: Statistical correlation of paired data
nodes.nameZh: 成对数据的统计相关性

nodes.description: For paired samples with nonzero variation in both variables, the sample correlation r describes the direction and strength of linear association and lies in [-1,1]. Centered cross-products contribute to its calculation. If either variable is constant, r is undefined.
nodes.name: Sample correlation coefficient

nodes.description: 比较线性相关的强弱时看 |r|。绝对值更大，线性相关更强；符号只表示方向。
nodes.name: Comparing the Strength of Correlations

nodes.description: Simple linear regression represents a response as a+b*x plus a random error. Identify explanatory and response variables, and calculate the fitted line value without the error term. The slope b may be zero.
nodes.name: Simple Linear Regression Model

nodes.description: 最小二乘法选择使残差平方和最小的直线。残差是观测值减去预测值。
nodes.name: Least Squares Principle

nodes.description: For observations (x_i,y_i) with nonzero variation in x, the least-squares slope is b=(n*sum(x_i*y_i)-sum(x_i)*sum(y_i))/(n*sum(x_i^2)-(sum(x_i))^2), and intercept a=mean(y)-b*mean(x). If all x values coincide, the usual slope formula is undefined and the slope is not uniquely determined.
nodes.name: Least Squares Estimation of Regression Coefficients
nodes.nameZh: 回归系数的最小二乘估计

nodes.description: 把新的 x 代入回归直线，得到 y 的预测值。预测是估计，不是确定的观测。
nodes.name: Making Predictions Using a Regression Line

nodes.description: 两个分类变量各有两类时，可以排成 2×2 列联表，并计算行合计、列合计和总数。
nodes.name: 2×2 Contingency Tables

nodes.description: 独立性检验先假设两个分类变量独立，再看观测到的列联表是否偏离这个假设太远。
nodes.name: The Idea Behind a Test of Independence

nodes.description: For a 2 by 2 count table with positive row and column totals, Pearson chi-square is n*(ad-bc)^2/((a+b)*(c+d)*(a+c)*(b+d)). A larger statistic is stronger evidence against independence under the test assumptions. It depends on sample size and is not an association effect size; zero margins make this formula undefined.
nodes.name: The Test Statistic for a Test of Independence

nodes.description: 用成对数据建立回归模型：提出问题、整理数据、估计直线，再用残差或新数据检验预测。
nodes.name: Building Statistical Models for Prediction
nodes.nameZh: 建立统计模型进行预测

nodes.description: 能在数量和数字之间来回，认读并写出 1 到 5。
nodes.name: Understanding the Numbers 1 to 5

nodes.description: 会用大于、小于、等于比较 5 以内的数。
nodes.name: Comparing Numbers up to 5

nodes.description: 能分清「有几个」和「第几个」。
nodes.name: Cardinal and Ordinal Numbers

nodes.description: 知道 5 以内的数可以分成哪两个数，又可以合起来。
nodes.name: Breaking Apart and Combining Numbers up to 5

nodes.description: 知道 0 表示一个也没有，会读写 0。
nodes.name: Understanding 0

nodes.description: 会计算得数不超过 5 的加法。
nodes.name: Addition within 5

nodes.description: 会计算 5 以内的减法。
nodes.name: Subtraction within 5

nodes.description: 能认、读、写 6 到 10，知道 10 是由 10 个一组成的。
nodes.name: Understanding the Numbers 6 to 10

nodes.description: 会比较 10 以内两个数的大小。
nodes.name: Comparing Numbers within 10

nodes.name: Building and drawing shapes

nodes.description: The three medians meet at the centroid, dividing each median 2:1 from its vertex; use the resulting coordinate and equal-area relations.
nodes.name: Centroid ratios and median area relations
nodes.nameZh: 重心比例与中线面积关系

nodes.description: For planar endpoints outside a disk, find a shortest path allowed on or outside its boundary. Use the straight segment if admissible; otherwise compare tangent-segment and boundary-arc paths on the two sides, including limiting tangencies.
nodes.name: Shortest paths around a circular obstacle
nodes.nameZh: 绕圆形障碍的最短路径

nodes.description: Read and write times shown in five-minute increments on analog and digital clocks, and use a.m. or p.m. to locate the time within a day.
nodes.name: Reading clocks in five-minute intervals

nodes.description: Read and write whole-hour and half-hour times, connecting analog hand positions with digital notation.
nodes.name: Reading clocks to the hour and half hour

nodes.name: Common tangent counts for two circles

nodes.description: For a real a!=0, rewrite a*x^2+b*x+c identically as a*(x+b/(2*a))^2+c-b^2/(4*a) by adding and subtracting the matching square term. nodes.description: Write nonzero z=r(cos t+i sin t), multiply moduli and add arguments, and use integer power or root formulas with arguments modulo 2 pi.

nodes.name: Complex solutions of real quadratic equations

nodes.description: For nonzero real-coefficient polynomials, conjugate roots have equal multiplicity. For complex coefficients, verify a conjugation identity or change of variable before inferring a transformed root symmetry; nonreal roots pair.
nodes.name: Conjugation symmetries of polynomial roots
nodes.nameZh: 多项式根的共轭对称性

nodes.description: Use forward or backward counting to represent addition and subtraction within 20, keeping track of how many one-unit changes are made.
nodes.name: Connecting counting with addition and subtraction

nodes.name: Elliptical sections of a right circular cylinder

nodes.description: Evaluate a binary operation supplied by a formula, a selection rule or a finite table. Respect the ordered operands and parentheses when nesting operations; do not assume ordinary multiplication or unstated algebraic laws.

nodes.nameZh: 自定义二元运算的求值

nodes.nameZh: 指定定义域上的反函数

nodes.nameZh: 反正切主值与正切方程的解

nodes.nameZh: 平面线性不等式组与半平面

nodes.name: Products of nonnegative integers

nodes.name: Zero-sum criterion for nonnegative real terms
nodes.nameZh: 非负实数项的零和判定

nodes.description: Numerical estimation seeks a quick, reasonable approximate quantity, often to judge scale or check plausibility. It does not promise an exact answer and is not restricted to one arithmetic operation.
nodes.name: Purpose and meaning of numerical estimation
nodes.nameZh: 数值估算的意义与用途

nodes.description: In the school oblique-dimetric convention, the projected planar axes meet at 45 or 135 degrees. Distinguish this chosen axis convention from perpendicular source axes and separate length scaling rules.
nodes.name: Projected axes in oblique dimetric drawing
nodes.nameZh: 斜二测画法的投影轴约定

nodes.description: On a specified set, check operation definedness and closure; prove or refute commutativity, associativity, identities, inverses and stated distributive laws from the operation rules and full domain.
nodes.name: Closure and identities of defined operations
nodes.nameZh: 自定义运算的封闭性与运算法则

nodes.description: Track finite ordered stacks under stated push, pop, move and reversal rules. Preserve which end is on top. Use the same representation to test a last-in-first-out output order or to track layers moved by a paper fold.
nodes.name: Ordered stacks and folded layers
nodes.nameZh: 有序堆栈与折叠层次的模拟

nodes.description: In one Euclidean plane, the locus of points equidistant from two distinct parallel lines is their midparallel. The locus at a fixed perpendicular distance d>0 from one line consists of its two parallel offsets; for d=0 it is the original line. Establish both directions and count intersections within this same plane.
nodes.name: Distance loci for parallel lines

nodes.description: Describe the two-dimensional figure formed where a plane slices a solid, including right rectangular prisms and right rectangular pyramids. Relate the section's edges and vertices to the faces and edges cut by the plane, and explain how changing the slice changes its shape.
nodes.name: Plane sections of solid figures

nodes.description: The total numerical coefficient sum of a real polynomial is its value with every variable set to 1. For one variable, use P(1) and P(-1) to recover the sums of even- and odd-power coefficients.
nodes.name: Polynomial coefficient sums by evaluation

nodes.description: For a nonconstant real polynomial, its leading term determines the signs and unbounded growth of the two tails as x tends to positive or negative infinity. Use degree parity and the leading coefficient sign.
nodes.name: Polynomial end behavior

nodes.description: Use P=DQ+R with degree R less than degree D; division by x-a leaves P(a), and x-a is a factor exactly when P(a)=0.
nodes.name: Polynomial division, remainders, and factors
nodes.nameZh: 多项式除法、余式与因式定理

nodes.description: Relate coefficients to elementary symmetric expressions in all roots, with multiplicity, and use root equations to simplify higher powers.
nodes.name: Polynomial root and coefficient identities
nodes.nameZh: 多项式根与系数恒等式

nodes.description: Use equal directed secant products through a point; for a point outside a circle, tangent length squared equals external times whole secant length.
nodes.name: Power of a point and secant products

nodes.description: Express n>1 uniquely as a product of prime powers and use exponents for divisibility, perfect powers, greatest common divisors, and least common multiples.
nodes.name: Prime factorization and exponent structure
nodes.nameZh: 质因数分解与指数结构

nodes.description: Track the prime exponent v_p(n) in products and factorials; use v_p(n!)=sum floor(n/p^k) for divisibility, perfect powers, and trailing zeros.
nodes.name: Prime valuations and factorial divisibility
nodes.nameZh: 质因数赋值与阶乘整除

nodes.description: Design and run a random simulation of a compound event. Choose a device and an outcome mapping that match the specified probabilities and dependence assumptions, define one complete trial and its success condition, repeat trials, and use the observed success frequency to approximate the probability.
nodes.name: Simulating compound chance events

nodes.description: Evaluate finite propositional formulas with NOT, AND, OR and material implication. Test schematic logical equivalence over all truth assignments, including De Morgan laws and contraposition. Distinguish schematic equivalence from two statements merely being true in a particular mathematical interpretation.
nodes.name: Truth operations and equivalence of propositions
nodes.nameZh: 命题的真值运算与逻辑等价

nodes.description: For a convex cyclic quadrilateral, the product of the diagonals equals the sum of the products of opposite sides; verify cyclicity before use.
nodes.name: Ptolemy theorem for cyclic quadrilaterals

nodes.description: For finite possible worlds and private observations, a participant knows a proposition when it holds in every indistinguishable world. Apply truthful public announcements by removing inconsistent worlds and recomputing observation classes.
nodes.name: Knowledge from private observations and public announcements
nodes.nameZh: 私有观察与公开陈述下的知识推断

nodes.description: For a>0 and a!=1, substitute t=a^x>0 to reduce suitable exponential equations to a quadratic in t. Keep only positive t roots, invert the exponential relation, and verify all recovered real solutions.
nodes.name: Quadratic substitution in exponential equations

nodes.description: Use an affine relation or a shared squared expression to eliminate a variable in a two-variable polynomial system and derive a condition of degree at most two. Check degree degeneracy, recover the other variable, and enforce real and original-domain constraints before accepting solution pairs.
nodes.name: Elimination and real feasibility in quadratic systems
nodes.nameZh: 二次方程组的消元与实解可行性

nodes.description: Four positive lengths form a nondegenerate simple quadrilateral exactly when the longest is less than the sum of the other three. Equality is degenerate; establish sufficiency with an admissible shared-diagonal construction.
nodes.name: Feasibility of four quadrilateral sides
nodes.nameZh: 四边形四边长度的可行条件

nodes.description: Decide whether all/some/no premises entail a conclusion by tracking a common existential witness and universal restrictions. To refute entailment, build one interpretation satisfying all premises and falsifying the conclusion.
nodes.name: Quantified inference and countermodels
nodes.nameZh: 量化命题的推理与反例模型

nodes.description: Solve real equations with unknowns inside radicals, respecting even-root domains and signs; check candidates in the original equation after taking powers or substituting.
nodes.name: Solving real equations containing radicals

nodes.description: Obtain the eventually periodic decimal expansion of a rational number by exact division or a verified repeated-block identity. Track any nonrepeating prefix and use the repetend length to locate a requested decimal digit.
nodes.name: Repeating decimals and periodic digit positions
nodes.nameZh: 有理数循环小数与周期位次

nodes.description: Solve real rational inequalities by locating numerator zeros and every original denominator zero, including excluded removable holes. Determine signs on the resulting intervals and apply strict or weak endpoint rules without restoring excluded inputs after cancellation. Do not multiply by a denominator of unknown sign unchecked.
nodes.name: Sign analysis of rational inequalities
nodes.nameZh: 分式不等式的符号分析

nodes.description: Use integer-fraction representations to justify rational closure under addition and multiplication, and use reverse arithmetic to show that adding a rational to an irrational or multiplying an irrational by a nonzero rational gives an irrational. Justify rational additive inverses and reciprocals of nonzero rationals for these reverse arguments, preserving the nonzero condition.
nodes.name: Rational closure and irrationality under arithmetic

nodes.description: For positive bases and real exponents, apply exponent-sum, exponent-difference, and power-of-power laws. Evaluate combined powers from given values and check domain restrictions.
nodes.name: Laws of positive-base real powers
nodes.nameZh: 正底数实数指数幂的运算法则

nodes.description: Use cot(t)=cos(t)/sin(t), csc(t)=1/sin(t), sec(t)=1/cos(t), and sin(2t)=2sin(t)cos(t) with existing same-angle or cosine double-angle identities. Preserve every denominator restriction.
nodes.name: Reciprocal and double-angle trigonometric identities
nodes.nameZh: 三角函数的倒数关系与二倍角恒等变形

nodes.description: Divide a rectangle into complete rows and columns of equal squares and count the squares in the resulting array.
nodes.name: Partitioning rectangles into square grids

nodes.description: Choose states retaining the information needed for the next step. Construct count or probability recurrences, or first-step equations for expected remaining cost/waiting time with transition probabilities and per-step cost. Apply initial or absorbing conditions. For an infinite-horizon expectation, justify finiteness or establish the intended minimal nonnegative solution before treating a solved linear system as the expectation.
nodes.name: Counts, probabilities, and expected waiting times by state recursion
nodes.nameZh: 状态递推计数、概率与期望等待时间

nodes.description: Interpret nested radicals and positive right-associated power towers as limits of finite iterates. Justify convergence before passing through a continuous recursion to a fixed-point equation, and select the attainable fixed point.
nodes.name: Limits of recursive infinite expressions
nodes.nameZh: 递归无限表达式的极限

nodes.description: Encode repeated decimal digits as finite geometric sums and determine exact product digits using place-value identities and justified carries or borrowing. Prove a proposed long digit pattern before taking its digit sum.
nodes.name: Exact decimal digits of repdigit products
nodes.nameZh: 重复数字乘积的十进制数位分析

nodes.description: Convert an eventually repeating base-ten decimal to a rational fraction by aligning and subtracting repeated tails, or by a convergent geometric series. Account for any nonrepeating prefix and reduce the fraction.
nodes.name: Converting repeating decimals to fractions

nodes.description: Study complex solutions of z^n=1 and scaled variants, using cyclic products, sums, regular-polygon geometry, and distinct-root counts.
nodes.name: Roots of unity and cyclic complex roots
nodes.nameZh: 单位根与复数根的循环结构

nodes.description: For distinct coordinate points \(A,B\) and a positive ratio \(AP:PB=m:n\), find the internal point \(P=A+\frac{m}{m+n}(B-A)\). The fraction is measured from the first named endpoint; reversing the direction changes which fraction is used. Scope is internal division, not external division.
nodes.name: Partitioning a directed segment in a given ratio

nodes.description: For a simple polygon with cyclically ordered vertices, area is half the absolute value of the alternating coordinate-product sum.
nodes.name: Coordinate polygon area by shoelace
nodes.nameZh: 鞋带公式求坐标多边形面积

nodes.description: For plane regions with positive finite area, a similarity with length factor k>0 multiplies area by k^2. Apply squared area ratios, including homothetic figures.
nodes.name: Area scaling of similar plane figures
nodes.nameZh: 相似平面图形的面积缩放

nodes.description: For geometrically similar solids with positive finite surface area, uniform length scaling by k>0 multiplies surface area by k^2. Under an explicitly assumed constant paint use per unit area, scale coating quantity by k^2 and by object count. The constant-coverage model is the usual thin-layer idealization; equal absolute coating thickness alone does not make finite-thickness coating volumes scale exactly by k^2.
nodes.name: Surface-area scaling of similar solids
nodes.nameZh: 相似立体的表面积缩放

nodes.description: For solids with positive finite volume, a uniform length scale factor k>0 multiplies volume by k^3. Use cubic volume ratios for scale models and inverse calculations.
nodes.name: Volume scaling of similar solids

nodes.description: Solve several integer remainder conditions, checking compatibility for noncoprime moduli and the solution period given by their least common multiple.
nodes.name: Simultaneous integer congruences

nodes.description: For sin(x)-(a*x+b), a!=0, bound all real roots and count them by half-waves. Positive sine half-waves are strictly concave and negative ones strictly convex; use endpoint signs or valid monotonicity bounds.
nodes.name: Counting sine-line intersections
nodes.nameZh: 正弦曲线与直线的交点计数

nodes.description: Construct a line plot of measurements in halves, quarters, or eighths of a unit and solve contextual questions using its values and frequencies. Apply addition and subtraction with like or unlike denominators, fraction multiplication, and division of unit fractions by positive whole numbers or of whole numbers by unit fractions. Explain equal redistribution of a plotted fractional total with a drawing or a decomposition into unit fractions.
nodes.name: Plotting fractional measurements and solving fraction-operation problems

nodes.description: In three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates, reflection in a coordinate plane negates its perpendicular coordinate. A half-turn about a coordinate axis keeps that coordinate and negates the other two. Compose these maps in the stated order.
nodes.name: Coordinate-plane reflections and axis half-turns
nodes.nameZh: 空间坐标平面反射与坐标轴半周旋转

nodes.description: For R>r>0, internal sphere contact has d=R-r; external contact of positive radii has d=R+r. Sphere-plane contact has perpendicular center distance r. Keep containment and plane-side conditions.
nodes.name: Center distances for tangent spheres
nodes.nameZh: 相切球的球心距离条件

nodes.description: For a sphere of radius r>=0, its volume is V=(4/3)*pi*r^3. Use the formula with consistent cubic units, distinguish radius from diameter, and compare it with volumes of other solids.
nodes.name: Volume of a sphere

nodes.description: The standard normal distribution is N(0,1), with mean 0, variance 1 and standard deviation 1. An interval within k standard deviations of its mean has endpoints -k and k for k>=0.
nodes.name: Standard normal distribution

nodes.description: Count fixed-sum nonnegative or positive integer solutions by placing separators among units; account for bounds and distinguishable variables.
nodes.name: Counting integer compositions by separators
nodes.nameZh: 隔板法与整数分拆计数

nodes.description: A statistical question anticipates variability in the data collected to answer it, and its answer accounts for that variability. Identify the attribute and observational units, distinguish such questions from questions about a fixed fact, and recognize that a mean or proportion can summarize varying observations in one number.
nodes.name: Statistical questions and anticipated variability

nodes.description: In triangle ABC, let D lie on BC, BC=a, BD=m, DC=n, AC=b, AB=c, and AD=d. Stewart theorem gives b^2*m+c^2*n=a*(d^2+m*n). The median special case is d^2=(2*b^2+2*c^2-a^2)/4. Require a=m+n and nondegenerate triangle/configuration conditions.
nodes.name: Stewart theorem and median lengths
nodes.nameZh: 斯图尔特定理与中线长度

nodes.description: In a finite pile game, include the player to move and the stated removal, terminal and pass rules in each state. Classify optimal winning and losing states by backward induction; prove any repeating residue strategy.
nodes.name: Optimal strategies in finite subtraction games
nodes.nameZh: 有限取物游戏的最优策略

nodes.description: Use a^3+b^3=(a+b)(a^2-ab+b^2) and a^3-b^3=(a-b)(a^2+ab+b^2), preserving surrounding expression domain restrictions.
nodes.name: Sum and difference of cubes identities

nodes.description: Count arrangements identified by specified rotations or reflections using orbit reasoning, fixed arrangements, or a justified canonical representative.
nodes.name: Counting arrangements up to symmetry

nodes.description: For tan(t)=sin(t)/cos(t), exclude t=pi/2+k*pi. It has period pi and is continuous and strictly increasing on each intervening branch, from -infinity to +infinity. Keep poles and branch endpoints explicit.
nodes.name: Tangent branches, continuity, and monotonicity
nodes.nameZh: 正切函数的分支、连续性与单调性

nodes.description: Rewrite consecutive terms or factors so internal contributions cancel in a finite sum or product; retain endpoints and nonzero-denominator restrictions.
nodes.name: Telescoping sums and products

nodes.description: For a nondegenerate triangle relate area K, semiperimeter s, inradius r, and circumradius R by K=rs and K=abc/(4R).
nodes.name: Triangle area, inradius, and circumradius
nodes.nameZh: 三角形面积与内外接圆半径

nodes.description: For adjacent sides \(a,b>0\) and included angle \(0<C<\pi\) in a nondegenerate triangle, derive \(K=\tfrac12 ab\sin C\) by constructing an altitude and substituting its trigonometric expression into the base-height formula. Account for right and obtuse configurations.
nodes.name: Deriving the sine formula for triangle area

nodes.description: A unit vector has magnitude exactly 1. Distinguish unit vectors from zero vectors, arbitrary nonzero vectors and vectors whose direction happens to be a coordinate axis.
nodes.name: Unit vectors

nodes.description: Find totals, purchases and change involving US dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels and pennies. Calculate in whole dollars or whole cents and express the result in the chosen unit.
nodes.name: Word problems with US dollars and cents

nodes.description: A unit cube has side length one chosen length unit and volume one cubic unit. A solid filled by n such cubes without gaps or overlaps has volume n cubic units. Measure volume by packing and counting cubes, including cubes hidden in a model or drawing, and state the cubic unit used.
nodes.name: Measuring volume by counting unit cubes
